project_name: Roofline Milestone 1 — Phase 1 (Foundation): Roof Segmentation & Human-in-the-Loop Annotation Studio
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / COMMAND CENTER CVAT & LABEL STUDIO STYLE
theme: Dark Command Center (Dark Slate/Obsidian #090D16 base with rich high-contrast overlays, vivid signal badges, and glowing canvas HUD)

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100

layout_strategy.spacing_scale: p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8 for cards; strict dense layouts in workspace with 1px border grid separators

layout_strategy.right_inspector_panel: lg:col-span-3 border-l border-slate-800 bg-[#0B0F19] flex flex-col h-full overflow-y-auto p-4 gap-4

features: App Title with SAM2 GPU indicator badge
Tab switcher: Checkpoint Dashboard | Dataset Gallery | Annotation Workspace | House Groups | Leakage Report
Quick Stats ticker: Batch 1 & 2 (217 images), Approved count, Leakage check status
Keyboard shortcuts modal toggle trigger
Ingestion Summary Card: 217 total roof images across 2 distinct batches
House Group Breakdown: grouping logic to prevent data leakage across train/val/holdout splits
Split Visualizer: Train (70%), Val (15%), Holdout (15%) with house-group integrity verification
Leakage Check Status Banner: Green Passed badge confirming 0 house_group overlaps across splits
GPU / CPU / CUDA Hardware Report Card: PyTorch 2.4, CUDA 12.1, SAM2-Hiera-Large active model, GPU VRAM meter
QA Scripts Runner & Status Table: check_eave_drip_edges.py, verify_gable_exclusions.py, validate_15pct_occlusions.py, check_parapet_naming.py
Filter bar by Status (All, Pending, Approved, Needs Review), Batch (Batch 1, Batch 2), and House Group
Search by Image ID or House Group ID
Grid view with high-res thumbnails, status badges, plane count pill, and house group chip
Quick action hover menu: Open in SAM2 Studio, Mark Needs Review, Quick Approve
Interactive HTML5/Canvas viewer with Zoom (10% - 800%), Pan, Fit-to-screen
SAM2 Prompting mode: Left-click for Positive (+) point prompt, Right-click/Shift-click for Negative (-) point prompt
Manual correction tools: Brush tool (size slider), Eraser, Polygon Tool for crisp edge adjustments
Plane Layer Manager: Drag-to-reorder, visiblity toggle (eye icon), color picker, rename plane, -parapet suffix toggle
Plane Checklist Verification Panel: Eave/Gutter Lip verified check, Drip Edge verified check, Gable Wall excluded check, Occlusion < 15% rule badge
Toolbar controls: Overlay Opacity Slider (0% - 100%), Toggle Mask Overlay button (Shortcut: 'O'), Invert Colors ('I'), Reset View ('R')
Action Bar: Previous ('A' or Left Arrow), Next ('D' or Right Arrow), Mark Needs Review ('N'), Approve & Generate JSON ('S' or Enter)
Visual House Group clusters (grouping multi-view images of the same residence)
Confidence / Uncertainty score flags for automated clustering
Interactive Merge & Split controls for house groups
Anti-leakage impact preview before confirming group edits
Full split matrix table with house_group hash validation
Leakage detector status (0 overlap guaranteed)
Download split configuration JSON & CSV export

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-performance, dark command center application tailored for computer vision engineers and roof segment annotators.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, canvas controls, search inputs, tabs, status badges) include explicit 'data-testid' attributes in kebab-case format.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for auto-save feedback, shortcut triggers, SAM2 mask generation events, and approval status updates.
Ensure the canvas viewer allows interactive point prompts, polygon drawing, brush strokes, opacity toggle, and full keyboard shortcut control.
Provide realistic mock data for all 217 dataset images, 45 house groups, split checks, and hardware CUDA environment specs so the application feels fully functional.
All components must be written in standard React JS (.js / .jsx extension) using Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
